content:
cheng: quick async standup — brief status on KMS/IAM rotation dry-run

cheng: what I did:
- kicked off dry-run of KMS key rotation for dedicated clusters (no live roll)
- ran service-account IAM scan across `redwood-*` projects, flagged ~9 accounts with overly permissive roles
- opened infra PR to narrow roles and add an e2e IAM smoke test: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/799

cheng: blockers:
- dry-run canary failed in eu-west1 with `crypto.RotationError: key not found` during re-encrypt step
- need infra sign-off on maintenance window; ETL jobs in eu-west1 have a tight nightly window

cheng: today:
- dig into canary logs and find where key reference came from
- swap canary to use latest secret version and re-run dry-run
- get two window options from @sarah for real rotation

sarah: on it — I'll check ETL schedule and propose windows (one late-eu and one early-us) by 4pm. will also add tentative calendar hold with runbook link.

alex: I looked at the canary logs — decrypt fails while calling kms-client `Decrypt` with 403. stack trace has `ServiceAccountPermissionDenied`. suspect the service account lost the encrypter role in the dry-run policy.

maria: FYI the secrets-sync job sometimes lags and returns an older secret version; if the deployment template pins `SECRET_VERSION` it can surface as a "missing key" during rotation. worth checking deploy template variables.

cheng: good note @maria. alex, can you grep the deploy template for SECRET_VERSION and KEY_RESOURCE? if it's pinned we'll switch to latest version lookup.

ops-bot: CI: canary job cc-2024-15 queued for restart by ops-bot. Estimated time ~7m.

alex: grep done — deploy template had KEY_REF set to `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/serve-old/cryptoKeyVersions/2`. that's the issue — pinned version 2 instead of referencing `latest`. opened https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/421 to remove hard pin and fallback to metadata lookup.

samir: will review infra PR 799 tonight. small note: when tightening IAM, remember to add an allowlist for backup/restore jobs so we don't break DB ops. also +1 on adding infra-e2e IAM check.

cheng: plan of action:
- alex: land deploy PR 421 to unpin KEY_REF and add fallback to query latest key version
- samir: review infra PR 799 and add backup allowlist note
- sarah: propose maintenance windows and post calendar hold with runbook
- me: re-run dry-run after deploy PR merges and validate canary

maria: reminder — third-party access audit item #47 is due next Wed. I'll post a checklist and assign reviewers later today.

cheng: small additional item — SCA flagged `pem-utils@1.3.0` (moderate) used in key tooling. I forked a patch branch and will open a PR for upgrade + CI check.

alex: re-run succeeded after removing pinned version. canary now hits KMS and returns `200` on decrypt. pushing a short smoke test harness to infra-e2e.

sarah: windows proposed: 2024-06-12 02:00–03:30 UTC (preferred) or 2024-06-14 22:00–23:30 UTC (backup). holding provisional invite w/ runbook.

cheng: perfect. will tag on-call and ops 1 hour before; if everyone reviews PRs today we can schedule a controlled rotation on the preferred window. thanks all. :thumbsup:
